g.text: SCR09 — Protected owner approval
Kotlin Compose screen definition · FR-ARC-04 / canonical Ask approval · blueprint2.0 design only
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled · 10
Phone390dp: Single protected exact-command sheet; no navigation; Approve, Deny and immutable challenge only. No drawer or destination route on protected
SCR09; Back denies current challenge. Landscape: Same IDs and authorization; wide layout only when available width>=840dp; never shrink protected actions
below48dp.
SCR09.C01 · Authenticate and approve
Fields: Exact command hash/scope/revisions,nonce,original deadline and queue position
Invoke fresh platform strong biometric/device credential prompt after input/capture quiescence
Failure: Expiry/CAS change/lockout/no enrollment/drain failure denies; only original exact approved command may commit
SCR09.C02 · Deny / dismiss
Fields: Current challenge ID; FIFO queue excluding expired entries
Deny selected challenge and return its request with structured denial
Failure: Back/system dismiss is the same denial; no side effect, no hidden next approval
SCR09.C03 · Locked navigation
Fields: Only Deny/Back or completed challenge exits
Navigation drawer is absent/disabled while protected review is active
Failure: No remote input,deep link or notification action may invoke Approve
SCR09.C04 · Inspect exact challenge
Fields: Principal/operation/hash/revisions/phase,queued count; secrets redacted
Show exact immutable challenge and current monotonic remaining time
Failure: Changed plan terminates review; owner must open a newly issued challenge
State definitions — exact enabled/disabled controls, effects and recovery
SCR09.S0 · Exact local challenge: quiesced and unexpired
Disabled: SCR09.C03
Effect: No remote input/capture; one immutable command waits for platform proof.
Recovery: Authenticate once or Deny/Back; queue is FIFO by issued time excluding expired requests.
SCR09.S1 · Expired challenge: no execution
Disabled: SCR09.C01, SCR09.C03
Effect: Capability unusable; original request receives denial/expiry.
Recovery: Dismiss; changed intent requires a newly prepared challenge, never renewal in place.
SCR09.S2 · Plan/revision changed: no execution
Disabled: SCR09.C01, SCR09.C03
Effect: Exact command/CAS pins no longer match; old proof is inert.
Recovery: Dismiss then inspect updated diff and request fresh approval.
SCR09.S3 · Quiescence not proven: approval blocked
Disabled: SCR09.C01, SCR09.C03
Effect: Input/capture drain did not finish within2s; no OS prompt is opened.
Recovery: Deny/dismiss and inspect pending bridge work; do not widen isolation claim.
SCR09.S4 · Authentication unavailable/locked out
Disabled: SCR09.C01, SCR09.C03
Effect: No enrollment, strong authenticator unavailable or platform lockout; no capability issued.
Recovery: Deny; owner may fix OS prerequisite explicitly outside bridge, then prepare a new challenge.
SCR09.S5 · Authentication cancelled/failed
Disabled: SCR09.C01, SCR09.C03
Effect: No capability issued; selected request receives denial without side effect.
Recovery: Dismiss; no automatic retry or queue-wide approval.
